_notes.why_these_two_codes: 4410000 and 4420000 are the only account codes that appear as their own rows in BOTH RAW_SYSTEM(PL) and RAW_SYSTEM(EXP) - everything else in P/L is a P/L-only rollup (Revenue, GP1, ...) or an Expense-only detail line. This mirrors the real workbook's 검증 sheet, which reconciles exactly these two accounts per CCTR.
_notes.verified: At CCTR x MONTH granularity, both codes matched exactly (difference = 0) across all 44 CCTR and all 7 available months in the source workbook.
_notes.tolerance: warning_threshold and error_threshold are in the same currency unit as PERF. abs(difference) <= warning_threshold -> PASS; <= error_threshold -> WARNING; above that -> ERROR. Adjust as real-world rounding behavior is better understood.
